description: A lightweight protocol for AI agents to discover, evaluate, purchase, and install MCP skills. Built on top of MCP, A2A, and JSON-RPC.

how_agents_find_us: A2A: GET /.well-known/agent.json — Agent Card with capabilities
Manifest: GET /api/manifest — all endpoints in one call

stdio.description: Standard MCP stdio transport. Works with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Cline.

agent_workflow.step_5_install: Run the install command from the skill detail
agent_workflow.step_6_pay: POST /api/agent-purchase — pay with USDC on Base or Stripe

levels.safe_to_install: trust_score >= 8 — agent can install without human approval
levels.install_with_caution: trust_score 5-7 — agent should warn human before installing
levels.high_risk_review_before_install: trust_score 2-4 — agent should NOT install without explicit human approval
levels.do_not_install: trust_score 0-1 — agent should refuse to install

agent_registration.description: Agents can register themselves to build reputation and get personalized recommendations
agent_registration.endpoint: POST /api/agent-register (coming soon — GitHub issue based for now)

fields.agent_type: coding | research | data | finance | communication | security
fields.capabilities: array — what the agent can do
fields.contact: string — how to reach the agent owner

failure_handling.decision_tree: agents use failure codes to self-diagnose and recover

payment.human_in_loop: AP2 mandates default to 'notify' mode — agents must opt into 'silent' mode
